content: @sentry/nextjs 10.74.0 peer range is next ^13.2 || ^14 || ^15 || ^16.0.0-0, engines node>=18, so Next 16 is officially supported. Setup is via 'npx @sentry/wizard@latest -i nextjs' which generates instrumentation-client.ts, sentry.server.config.ts, sentry.edge.config.ts, instrumentation.ts (registers server+edge), app/global-error.tsx for App Router React render errors, and wraps next.config with withSentryConfig for source-map upload and request tunneling past ad-blockers. Verify at /sentry-example-page.
